name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell above your shoulders using a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Wrap your thumbs securely around the bar and keep your upper arms steady and upright.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the bar smoothly toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows forcefully to raise the bar back up without moving your upper arms.
tips: Keep both thumbs wrapped firmly around the bar and your wrists locked straight.
Keep your elbows pointed upward rather than letting them flare outward.
